name: Wrath of God
overview: The Wrath of God is a righteous and holy response to sin, demonstrated in His judgment against the wicked while upholding justice for the righteous. Scripture reveals that God is continually angry with evil (Psalms 7:11) and will punish iniquity decisively, as seen in His coming judgment upon the earth (Isaiah 26:21). Believers are called to avoid anger and wrath themselves, responding instead with gentleness and obedience to God's commandments (Deuteronomy 28:1; Proverbs 15:1, 37:8). The contrast between the righteous and the wicked underscores the seriousness of God's wrath and the importance of faithfulness.
